reviews.body: Yes please. This would have saved us on the 11th.

comments.author: bob
comments.body: +1 on making this a hard rule rather than a suggestion. In #102 I said requests was fine "for now"; that was the wrong call in hindsight. Anything under app/ that talks HTTP should go through make_client, no exceptions except SDKs with their own transport.

comments.author: alice
comments.body: Agreed. I'll call it out in review from now on.

comments.author: dan
comments.body: Should callers still add their own retry around calls to, e.g., the card network? I was going to do that for the status poller.

comments.author: alice
comments.body: No. Retries live here and only here. If a caller also retries, you multiply attempts and a flaky downstream turns into a retry storm. If some call needs a different policy we'll add a parameter to make_client, not a loop at the call site.
